warnings: *** THREE NUMERIC TABLES THAT TOGETHER SIZE EVERY PIPE SUPPORT IN THE BUILDING: hanger spacing (12 pipe sizes x 7 materials x vertical/horizontal), clamp flat-bar size by pipe size, and hanger-rod diameter by pipe size. *** They are the only place any of this is specified.

FOR THIS HOUSE ONLY THE PVC COLUMN APPLIES (SN-01 makes every pipe PVC except the external concrete storm drain). The numbers that matter: ø2" PVC at 1.8 m vertical / 1.5 m horizontal, ø4" at 2.4 m both ways, with ø9 mm hanger rods up to 1 1/2" and ø12 mm from 2" to 3".

THE SPACING TABLE CANNOT BE READ ON ITS OWN. The cast-iron and copper columns contain cross-references ('ดูท้ายตาราง 2', '3', '4') instead of numbers, which resolve to the notes at the bottom: every storey and every joint (2), every 1.0 m and every joint (3), every 1.2 m and every joint (4). The table and its notes must travel together.
Note 1 is the governing rule regardless of spacing: EVERY length of pipe must have at least one support.
The under-slab detail requires MORE THAN 0.60 m of cover to ground, which is the same figure as the 'จุดต้นท่อลึก 0.60 ม' start-of-run marks on SN-04.
A FLEXIBLE CONNECTION is required where pipe passes from a ground-bearing slab into the ground -- the settlement joint. Easy to miss in a take-off and it is a specific fitting.
The table is dense and was transcribed cell by cell; flagged dense_numeric_table so a reviewer knows to spot-check it against the image rather than trust it blind.
One note under the hanging details is partly illegible at this scan resolution and is transcribed as read, flagged text_partly_illegible.
